PR: Upgrade to Pebble v2.7.0 [closed; labels size/L, release-note, approved, lgtm, kind/cleanup, dco-signoff: yes, area/testing]
The main reason that I'm upgrading Pebble to v2.7.0 is so that I can test ACME profiles in #7752.

We were using a very old version (https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/commit/ba5f81dd80fa870cbc19326f2d5a46f45f0b5ee3) from 2022, and there have been many changes in Pebble since then which break the cert-manager E2E tests.

Which is why this PR includes the following changes to the verifications and assertions in the E2E tests:
- The External Account Binding tests we…

uses go-jose v4 which requires 256bit keys for HS256 signatures. (https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/pull/445, https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/issues/455, https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/pull/428, https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/pull/459)
- Various ACME tests request a CN, but Pebble now drops the CN, causing the Certificate assertions to fail. (https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/pull/420)
